The structure of composition Mg2Si2O6 (reduced formula MgSiO3) adopts the trigonal R-3m space group (No. 166), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Si centers in tetrahedral environments coordinated by four O neighbors, while Mg centers have six O neighbors; these O centers are each coordinated by one Si and one Mg. Corner-sharing between Mg and Si polyhedra and edge-sharing among Mg-centered polyhedra are observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
